# autohotkey-test

AutoHotkey v2 scriptlet depot. 80+ scripts across games, productivity, system,
dev tools, and MCP integration. Includes ScriptletCOMBridge HTTP server on
port 10744 for list/run/stop from autohotkey-mcp.

## Key fixes applied (2026-07-05)

- **Bridge /run**: Replaced sync `& batfile` with `Start-Process`. No more timeouts.
- **Bridge /stop**: Uses `Get-CimInstance` for reliable process kill by command-line match.
- **Game text colors**: All dark-background controls now have explicit `cLime`/`cWhite`/`c4488FF`.
  Previously invisible black-on-black when system default text was dark.
- **Hotkeys**: Pong, Tetris, Frogger use `HotIf`-scoped instead of global guards.
  Keys (W/S, arrows, etc.) pass through to other apps when game window isn't focused.
- **Word Games**: Tab2 (dark page background), physical keyboard input, GDI+ Pong.

## Arcade Games (13 playable)

| Game | Rendering | Controls |
|------|-----------|----------|
| Classic Pong | GDI+ vector (green paddles, white ball) | W/S or arrows, Space=Start |
| Tetris | ASCII (green on black) | Arrows, Up=Rotate, Space=Drop |
| Frogger | ASCII (green on black) | Arrows |
| Pac-Man | ASCII (yellow on black) | Arrow keys |
| Q*bert | ASCII (green on black) | Arrows |
| Sudoku | Edit grid | Click + type |
| Chess | Board UI | Click to move, Stockfish AI |
| Word Games | Tabbed UI | Physical keyboard: type, Backspace, Enter |

## Bridge API

`http://127.0.0.1:10744` — PowerShell HttpListener:
- `GET /scriptlets` — JSON list of all 80+ scriptlets
- `GET /run/{name}` — Launch scriptlet via Start-Process
- `GET /stop/{name}` — Kill matching AutoHotkey64 process
- `GET /dashboard` — Serves dashboard.html
- `GET /status` — "Server running"

## Integration

Consumed by autohotkey-mcp via AUTOHOTKEY_SCRIPT_DEPOT and AUTOHOTKEY_BRIDGE_URL.
